query:
-- Verificar se existiam agendamentos de REGINA no dia 17 ANTES de hoje (createdAt < 2026-06-17)
SELECT a.id, a.startTime, a.createdAt, a.therapyType, a.status, p.name as patientName
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE a.therapistUserId = 4620148
AND DATE(a.startTime) = '2026-06-17'
AND a.createdAt < '2026-06-17 00:00:00'
ORDER BY a.startTime;
